Choosing your tile

Find the look that suits your space

Marble look

Soft veining on a pale base gives bathrooms and living areas a bright, classic feel. Our marble look tiles range from quiet white with fine grey lines to bold charcoal veins with touches of gold.

Stone look

Natural grain and gentle movement make a calm, hard wearing floor. Browse the stone look range in ivory, cream and grey tones for kitchens, living rooms and hallways.

Travertine look

Warm beige tones with the banding of cut travertine suit relaxed, natural interiors. See our travertine look tiles, including BT Travertine Vein Cut.

Terrazzo look

Stone fragments on a soft base add pattern and character without overpowering a room. The terrazzo look tiles work well on floors that need a little life.

Concrete look

Smooth, even colour for pared back, contemporary spaces. Our concrete look tiles pair easily with timber, stone and black tapware.

Indoor to outdoor

Some ranges are made for both sides of the door, so the floor can run from the living room to the alfresco. Filter for indoor and outdoor tiles to see them.

Tile questions

Good to know before you order

How many tiles should I order?

Measure the floor or wall area in square metres, then add about 10% for cuts and wastage. Our tiles are sold by the box, so add your area to any tile in your enquiry and we will show the number of boxes you need.

Can I see the tiles before I order?

Yes. Our showroom is at 43-45 Bonnyrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg, open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. Colour and veining vary between screens and batches, so we recommend seeing a tile in person.

Which tiles can I use outside?

Look for ranges marked indoor and outdoor, or tick the indoor and outdoor filter at the top of this page. If you are unsure whether a tile suits your area, call us on (02) 8786 0288.

Do you deliver?

You can pick up from our Bonnyrigg showroom or have your order delivered across Sydney metro. Choose either option when you send your enquiry and we will confirm the details with you.

What is a BT Special?

Every tile with BT in its name is a BT Special, chosen and imported directly by Bonnyrigg Tiles. Tick BT Specials only to see the full range.
